---
title: ""
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    toc: false
listing:
  - id: engagement-map-data
    contents: engagements/*.qmd
    template: engagements/map-data.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    page-size: 10000
    field-types:
      date: date
  - id: activities
    contents: engagements/*.qmd
    template: engagements/event-card.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    page-size: 6
    field-types:
      date: date
    #field-required: [title, date, description]
    date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
---

<!-- The map is built from the complete Quarto listing metadata, not just the visible page of cards. -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" integrity="sha256-p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyo85ZOg7Efo=" crossorigin="anonymous">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" integrity="sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="engagements/engagement-map.js" defer></script>

<!-- Quarto expands custom listings outside raw HTML sections. Relocate the generated
     event listing into the existing Events & Contributions section after rendering. -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const slot = document.getElementById('engagement-events-slot');
  const listing = document.getElementById('listing-activities');
  if (slot && listing && listing.parentElement !== slot) slot.appendChild(listing);
});
</script>
